'''Systems Engineering Director''' was a position in the organization [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] as well as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]. [[D. Beasley]] was one individual who held this position in both organizations.<ref name="ATATSpecPlate" />
